motion.name: portrait-ease
motion.purpose: 750ms arrival and 450ms hover; disabled with reduced motion.

components.name: Contribution
components.description: Select a contribution; selection is shared with its portrait.
components.css: .ds-contribution { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; width:100%; border:0; border-radius:6px; padding:11px 6px; color:#20211c; background:transparent; font:11px/1.5 Manrope,sans-serif; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; transition:background 180ms; } .ds-contribution:hover,.ds-contribution[aria-pressed='true'] { background:#efe9da; } .ds-contribution:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #9c4200; outline-offset:5px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-contribution { transition:none; } }
